parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ properties: { 'Next Review': { date: { start: $now.setZone($('Config').first().json.timezone).plus({ days: 1 }).toISODate() } } } }) }}

nodes.name: Mark As Sent
nodes.notes: Next Review -> tomorrow, so a second session the same day doesn't resend it. A button tap overrides it.

parameters.content:
## Active recall (also a sub-workflow)
Two ways in: **Every Hour** (sends only at each chat's /time hours) or **Review Requested** (called by /review in the main workflow, sends right away to that chat). Due words first; nothing due → one word early. Button taps come back through the main workflow, because a bot has one webhook.

nodes.name: Review Requested
nodes.notes: Called by /review in the main workflow, with the chat_id of the user who asked.
